findings.summary: The prescribed mechanical product-consistency check (git diff --exit-code e3414f64e4d9996d1b459a84dc5bb135f6322af6 0f9e2eb0504146464f2abb43250648cf4bfe2493 -- . ':(exclude).dev-dispatch') was not executed: every git invocation in this environment was refused as requiring approval, and this reviewer's role is read-only file inspection. Product consistency was instead assessed by direct inspection of the worktree, which shows product sources alongside .dev-dispatch metadata with no evidence of a product file altered by materialization. The verdict does not rest on this check; the deterministic seal verifies the actual HEAD.

The committed implement handoff records work_head_commit as 9d398a781a68d674843da2bb79c8726b0f743aa1, while the dispatch context supplied to this review names e3414f64e4d9996d1b459a84dc5bb135f6322af6 as the product commit (work_head_commit). The two are consistent only if e3414f64 is the metadata-only materialization stacked on 9d398a78, which is the expected shape but could not be confirmed with read-only file inspection. Flagged for the chain-verification layer, not treated as a product defect. The same discrepancy shape was raised in the attempt-1 final review.
